photos.desc: Bajuku River Turtle (Orlitia borneensis) is a type of turtle in the Bataguridae family. These turtles can be found in Indonesia . This turtle is usually called bajuku or biuku, dress, or ivory turtle.
Калимантанская черепаха (Orlitia borneensis) в Ленинградском зоопарке

Bajuku River Turtle (Orlitia borneensis) is a type of turtle in the Bataguridae family. These turtles can be found in Indonesia . This turtle is usually called bajuku or biuku, dress, or ivory turtle.
